title: Minecraft Behavior.swim Idle Misc
description: Allows the entity go idle, if swimming. Entity must be in water.

idle_time.title: Idle Time
idle_time.description: Amount of time (in seconds) to stay idle. Default value: 5.

success_rate.title: Success Rate
success_rate.description: Percent chance this entity will go idle, 1.0 = 100%. Default value: 0.1.
